entities.name: Nadine Apetz
entities.label: Person
entities.summary:
Nadine Apetz is a German amateur boxer. She won bronze medals at the World Championships in 2016 and 2018, and gold at the 2017 EU Championships. In 2021, she became the first German woman to qualify for a 
boxing event at the Summer Olympic Games.
